one_liner: Magento Open Source is free and self-hosted with broad REST/GraphQL APIs; auth is per-store OAuth 1.0a integrations or tokens, with no central app registry or multi-tenant OAuth2.
auth_notes: Third-party apps use OAuth 1.0a (signed requests) via merchant-created integrations. Admin/customer tokens are obtained by username/password (4h/1h). Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service uses Adobe IMS OAuth2 (client credentials), a separate narrower path.
access_notes: Magento Open Source core is free (OSL 3.0), so a developer can self-host a store and create an integration for working credentials. Adobe Commerce paid/cloud editions are sales-led, and Adobe's SaaS sandboxes require a partner program membership, but the free self-hosted path is sufficient to build and test.
blocker_notes: The free Magento Open Source build exposes the same web API, so a developer can self-host and create an integration for credentials. Self-hosting and per-merchant integrations are not rubric friction.
